구글 폼 · 본당 단체 부스 / 판매존 외부 신청: Google Form (Korean) · parish group booths / outside vendors
만남의 방 · 소성전 앞: Meeting Room · in front of the small chapel
22부스 이상 · 전체 수량은 신청에 따라 확정: 22+ booths · final number depends on applications
본부석은 안내·총괄, 정산, 분실물, 응급의료를 맡습니다. WYD 홍보부: The info desk handles information, coordination, accounts, lost and found, and first aid. The WYD booth introduces World Youth Day and raises funds.
묵주 팔찌, 나노블록 십자가, 양말목 성탄 오너먼트와 소원·기도 카드 나: Rosary bracelets, nanoblock crosses, sock-loop Christmas ornaments and a wish and prayer card tree.
메뉴마다 1부스 — 카페(핫초코·커피·쌍화차), 뱅쇼, 베이커리(쿠키·컵: One booth per menu — café (hot chocolate, coffee, ssanghwa tea), mulled wine, bakery (cookies, cupcakes) and three hot-snack booths (hot dogs and steamed buns / tteokbokki and fish cakes / pancakes). Choose a menu when you apply.
성물방과 지역 소상공인 입점, 크리스마스 리스 등 재능기부, 본당 단체: The religious goods shop and local small businesses, donated crafts such as Christmas wreaths, parish group booths and outside vendor booths.
구글 폼 신청을 담당자가 확인한 뒤 신청 순서대로 반영합니다. 같은 품목: Google Form applications are added in order once the organizer has checked them. Each item is limited to 2 booths, so please check which items are already taken before applying.
본당 단체는 단체당 1부스, 신청 순서대로 배정합니다. 신청할 때 희망: Each parish group gets one booth, assigned in order of application. Note your preferred zone (activity, snack or market) and items when applying.
같은 품목·테마는 먼저 신청한 단체가 우선이며 최대 2개 부스까지 열 수: For the same item or theme, the group that applies first has priority, up to 2 booths. Items for sale should be new.
판매존은 외부 신청도 받아요: Market zone open to outside vendors
단체 부스가 확정된 뒤 판매존의 남은 자리를 지역 주민·소상공인에게 엽니: Once group booths are set, remaining market-zone spots are opened to local residents and small businesses (11.15–11.25). The same-item rule applies and parish groups have priority.
행사 후 부스별 기부금 순위만 발표하고, 액수는 공개하지 않습니다. 수익: After the event we announce only the ranking of booth donations, not the amounts. Proceeds go to the WYD 2027 fund.
날짜와 운영 방식은 주임신부님 승인 후 확정되며, 바뀌면 이 페이지와 주: Dates and arrangements are final once approved by the pastor; any changes will be posted here and in the bulletin. Questions go to the parish WYD Spiritual Planning Team.
